question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a black ball, Bob has a purple ball, and Claire has a gold ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Bob and Alice swap balls. Then, Alice and Bob swap balls. Finally, Alice and Bob swap balls. At the end of the game, Alice has the
Options:
(A) black ball
(B) purple ball
(C) gold ball
solution:
Each row lists ball colors in holder order: Alice, Bob, Claire.
Initial: black, purple, gold
1. Bob and Alice swap: purple, black, gold
2. Alice and Bob swap: black, purple, gold
3. Alice and Bob swap: purple, black, gold
Alice has the purple ball, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
